=INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, customer_id, sender_type, content, intent, confidence, pii_detected, metadata)
VALUES (
  '{{ ($json.conversation && $json.conversation.id && $json.conversation.id !== "null" && $json.conversation.id !== "undefined") ? $json.conversation.id : "a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" }}'::uuid,
  '{{ ($json.customer && $json.customer.id && $json.customer.id !== "null" && $json.customer.id !== "undefined") ? $json.customer.id : "a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" }}'::uuid,
  'customer',
  '{{ ($json.sanitized_message || $json.customer_message || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.ai_output?.intent || "unknown" }}',
  {{ $json.ai_output?.confidence || 0 }},
  {{ $json.pii_detected ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE' }},
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.ai_output?.entities || {}).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
);

=INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, customer_id, sender_type, content, intent, confidence, metadata)
VALUES (
  '{{ ($('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.conversation && $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.conversation.id && $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.conversation.id !== "null" && $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.conversation.id !== "undefined") ? $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.conversation.id : "a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" }}'::uuid,
  '{{ ($('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.customer && $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.customer.id && $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.customer.id !== "null" && $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.customer.id !== "undefined") ? $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.customer.id : "a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" }}'::uuid,
  'ai',
  '{{ ($('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.final_reply || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.ai_output?.intent || "unknown" }}',
  {{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.ai_output?.confidence || 0 }},
  json_build_object('sentiment', '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.ai_output?.sentiment || "neutral" }}', 'locale', '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.locale || "ar" }}')
);

=INSERT INTO audit_logs (workflow_name, execution_id, event_type, channel, pii_masked, payload, latency_ms)
VALUES (
  '01_gateway_dispatcher',
  '{{ $execution.id || ("turn_" + Math.floor(Math.random() * 90000 + 10000)) }}',
  'turn_completed',
  '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.channel || "webchat" }}',
  {{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.pii_detected ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE' }},
  json_build_object(
    'intent', '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.ai_output?.intent }}',
    'status', '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.handler_status }}',
    'ticket_number', '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.ticket_number }}',
    'locale', '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.locale }}',
    'customer', '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.customer?.full_name }}'
  ),
  {{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.latency_ms || 0 }}
);
